about: Chat 8 (Fable), Oct 29 2026 ~10:15 PM. Who runs the parks in each POTA country outside the US + Canada, and where that agency keeps its own GIS. For the WORLD HARVESTER (chat 9): agency names + abbreviations go into GOVWORDS / native words, addresses into servers / catalogs / ogc. Grade C = from chat 8's own knowledge, TO VERIFY by the harvester or a look-up; A/B once a probe opens it. Protected Planet is used ONLY to read the agency's name (rule W-9), never its shapes.
rule_W9: Protected Planet (WDPA) = a phone book only: read the 'Sources' / 'Management Authority' name, write the name down, go to that agency's own site. Nothing else from it is read, drawn or stored.
